title: This GitHub Skill Turns an AI Agent Into Your Relationship Coach
description:
Someone dropped an AI relationship coach on GitHub, and its wild 🔥 It's a Codex skill that turns your agent into a personal relationship advisor. First it validates what your feeling, then hands you actual phrases and a game plan backed by psychology and family law 😅 The repo's in chinese but the pattern is the point: agents that help with life, not just code ✨
